crew crew-sop
models: capable=opencode-go/beam-free efficient=opencode-go/beam-free
roles (crew-declared): architect profile=Architect tier=capable
nodes:
  plan                     role=planner(Planner) model=opencode-go/beam-free writes=plan ENTRY
  design                   role=architect(Architect) model=opencode-go/beam-free writes=design watch=plan
                             ← rev-reviewer [verdict:lbtm] loop max_visits=2
                             ← sec-security_reviewer [verdict:fail] loop max_visits=2
                             ← adv-judge [verdict:revise] loop max_visits=2
                             ← plan [idle]
  rev-reviewer             role=reviewer(Reviewer) model=opencode-go/beam-free writes=review
                             ← design [idle]
  sec-security_reviewer    role=security_reviewer(Security reviewer) model=opencode-go/beam-free writes=security_review
                             ← design [idle]
                             ← rev-reviewer [verdict:lgtm]
  adv-critic-1             role=adversarial_reviewer(Adversary) model=opencode-go/beam-free writes=critique
                             ← design [idle]
                             ← sec-security_reviewer [verdict:pass]
  adv-critic-2             role=adversarial_reviewer(Adversary) model=opencode-go/beam-free writes=critique
                             ← design [idle]
                             ← sec-security_reviewer [verdict:pass]
  adv-critic-3             role=adversarial_reviewer(Adversary) model=opencode-go/beam-free writes=critique
                             ← design [idle]
                             ← sec-security_reviewer [verdict:pass]
  adv-judge                role=judge(Judge) model=opencode-go/beam-free writes=judgement
                             ← adv-critic-1 [idle]
                             ← adv-critic-2 [idle]
                             ← adv-critic-3 [idle]
  run-implement            role=engineer(Engineer) model=opencode-go/beam-free writes=implementation
                             ← design [idle]
                             ← run-verify [verdict:fail] loop max_visits=2
                             ← adv-judge [verdict:accept]
  run-verify               role=verifier(Verifier) model=opencode-go/beam-free writes=verification
                             ← run-implement [idle]
patterns:
  rev        reviewer_loop subject=design
  sec        security_review subject=design
  adv        adversarial_panel subject=design
  run        executor subject=design
checks:
  after run-implement        test -f SOP_DEMO.md
  after run-implement        grep -q 'sop pipeline works' SOP_DEMO.md
crew/examples/crew-sop.yaml valid
